## Description {#details}

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/hungoffoperandtraits">HungoffOperandTraits</a> - determine the allocation regime of the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/use">Use</a> array when it is not a prefix to the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/user">User</a> object, but allocated at an unrelated heap address.</p>


<p>This is the traits class that is needed when the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/use">Use</a> array must be resizable.</p>


<p>Definition at line 93 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/ir/operandtraits-h">OperandTraits.h</a>.</p>
